title: Magnetic Bead Purification and PCR Protocol
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Set up bead cleanup system
steps.instruction: Load ethanol wells in the reservoir according to sample number (1 well per 24 samples; e.g., 48 samples → 2 wells, 48‑72 samples → 3 wells) and distribute the same volume of ethanol evenly among those wells. The protocol will pause automatically when tips are depleted. Adjust the magnetic height variable so the magnet sits just below, but not touching, the bottom of the custom plate on the magnetic module. Place the reagent rack on the temperature module set to 4 °C to keep the master mix cool. Reserve the last 4 wells of the reservoir for trash.

steps.title: Centrifuge PCR plate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the Amplicon PCR plate at 1,000 × g, 20 °C for 1 minute to collect condensation, then carefully remove the seal.

steps.title: Transfer PCR to MIDI plate
steps.instruction: Using a multichannel pipette set to 25 µl, transfer the entire Amplicon PCR product from the PCR plate to the MIDI (96‑well) plate. Change tips between samples. (Optional: use a shaker for mixing after transfer.)

steps.title: Vortex beads and dispense
steps.instruction: Vortex the AMPure XP beads for 30 seconds to resuspend them fully, then add the appropriate volume of beads to a trough based on the number of samples being processed.

steps.title: Add beads to wells and mix
steps.instruction: Using a multichannel pipette, add 20 µl of AMPure XP beads to each well, then gently pipette the entire well volume up and down 10 times to mix.

steps.title: Incubate bead binding
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at room temperature without shaking for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Magnetic separation first
steps.instruction: Place the plate on a magnetic stand for 2 minutes or until the supernatant has cleared.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: With the plate on the magnetic stand, wash the beads with freshly prepared 80 % ethanol as described in the protocol.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Perform a second wash with freshly prepared 80 % ethanol while the plate remains on the magnetic stand.

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: Keep the plate on the magnetic stand and allow the beads to air‑dry for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Elute DNA in Tris
steps.instruction: Remove the plate from the magnetic stand and, using a multichannel pipette, add 52.5 µl of 10 mM Tris, pH 8.5, to each well. Change tips between samples.

steps.title: Resuspend beads
steps.instruction: Gently pipette the mixture up and down 10 times, changing tips after each pipette action, ensuring the beads are fully resuspended.

steps.title: Incubate elution
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Magnetic separation second
steps.instruction: Place the plate back on the magnetic stand for 2 minutes or until the supernatant clears.

steps.title: Transfer eluate
steps.instruction: Using a multichannel pipette, carefully transfer 50 µl of the cleared supernatant from the Amplicon PCR plate to a new 96‑well PCR plate. Change tips between samples to avoid cross‑contamination.
